top_signals.title: UBS Is Nudging Swiss Capital Debate Toward a Cheaper Compromise
top_signals.summary: Swiss lawmakers are focusing on a possible compromise in the debate over regulation of UBS Group AG which would potentially make it less expensive for the bank to meet the government’s $20 billion capital demand.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Junior consultants called back to office as AI increases need for human skills
top_signals.summary: Artificial intelligence has made interpersonal skills more valuable, executives say
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Republicans are dismissing affordability. That could be a problem in November
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump quipped that affordability was "devised" by Democrats, while Vice President JD Vance said groceries "cost what they cost."
